deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace, Multiverse Architect leads a planeswalker deck built around Reality Fracture's empower Jace, shared loyalty abilities, and creature-and-planeswalker exchange themes. Develop your mana, establish planeswalkers behind tokens, then use the Way enchantments to turn life gain, creature deaths, and loyalty activations into a growing advantage. Three central payoffs are Jace, Reality Sculptor's attack on opposing libraries, Sanctum Lurker's repeated drain, and Massacre Girl, Most Wanted's death-trigger damage; token armies and planeswalker emblems provide another route to victory. The deck favors gradual development over explosive starts, giving up speed for overlapping engines and protection, while its four-color costs and setup-heavy draws can leave it vulnerable to early pressure.

The quality model grades this deck at the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
